title: lint_sql_param_types.py does not detect 42P18 (untyped parameter in variadic-any context)
notes: Discovered during diagnosis of ISS-0120 (WF03-GH383-20260809). The linter only covers C42883 patterns (col::text = $N asymmetric cast and integer literal vs TEXT column). It does not detect parameters used inside variadic-any functions (jsonb_build_object, format, row) that cause 42P18 at prepare time. The 42P18 pattern is distinct from C42883 — PostgreSQL cannot infer the type, not that the cast is asymmetric.
root_cause: lint_sql_param_types.py regex patterns target col::text = $N (C42883) but not $N used in jsonb_build_object / format / row context (42P18).
candidate_resolution: Add a new MAJOR rule to lint_sql_param_types.py that flags bare $N parameters inside jsonb_build_object(...), format(...), row(...) and similar variadic-any functions. The fix is to require an explicit $N::type cast.
resolution: Extended lint_sql_param_types.py with VARIADIC_ANY_FUNCS frozenset, FUNC_CALL_RE, BARE_PARAM_IN_VARIADIC_RE, _extract_paren_block() helper, and lint_variadic_params() integrated into lint_file() as a new MAJOR-severity rule. Bare $N in jsonb_build_object/json_build_object/format/row now emits [MAJOR] 42P18 warning. Scan of src+tests exits 0/0/0. Synthetic test confirmed detection. WF03-GH610-20260809.
